errors.text_span: 蓝色柱状图位于左侧，橙色柱状图位于右侧，形成分组排列
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly states the blue bars (training set) are on the left and orange bars (validation set) are on the right within each category. The image shows both bars are grouped together, with no left-right separation within a category.

The reference description mentions the logical order of categories on the x-axis, but the machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the categories are arranged in a logical sequence.
